Results.ReviewText: I give this item a three star rating for a number of reasons.  First, I think three stars indicates that it meets my expectations and it does.  Having owned a Weber Genisis Silver model for over 20 years, this model looks good and cooks well.  However, Weber technical support is less than adequate.  While putting the grill together, I ran into a problem with step 4 in the manual.  I could not get the back panel holes to match up with the two side panels.  I called Weber.  The gentleman on the other end of the phone had a copy of the manual available to him and described the parts in the step as a "back panel, four screws, and four cylindrical disks".  Having some knowledge of terminology, I told him that the cylindrical disks were probably called "washers".  I feel that a person in a technical support position should know the term washers.  He ordered me a new back panel.  Two days later, while reorienting the parts left to install, I discovered that I was trying to install the back panel on the front of the grill and the back panel that was being shipped was not going to help. This was my mistake.   As I have accounts with both Fedex and UPS, I knew that back panel hadn't shipped so I called to cancel the shipping of the useless back panel.  I was told that this could not be done but if I called after receiving the back panel they would generate a return document and would pay for shipping.  I advised that if the back panel came, I would discard it rather than having to go to the trouble of returning an item that Weber knew wasn't wanted by the customer.  I was told that nothing could be done, but two days later, I received an Email stating that my shipment had been cancelled.  This points me to the conclusion that Weber customer service is less than adequate.
Results.Title: Customer Service Mishap

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
